theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_ccf_prime_power
theorems.statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ModularCurve.cuspCount (p ^ a) = (Finset.range (a + 1)).sum (fun j => Nat.totient (p ^ min j (a - j)))
